name: prezograph
description: Open-source graph-based presentations from versioned JSON, with safe deck selection, CLI validation, and offline export.

scripts.check: npm run validate && npm test && npm run build && npm run build:site
scripts.validate: node cli/prezograph.mjs validate examples/graphs-are-awesome/deck.json && node cli/prezograph.mjs validate examples/graphs-are-awesome/reviewed.deck.json
